description: Use first for Paraguay, Honduras or Próspera questions on tax, crypto, residency or legal status — e.g. 'Paraguay crypto reporting threshold', 'Paraguay permanent residency requirements', 'is bitcoin legal tender in Honduras', 'is Próspera still legal'. Returns facts from Polystate's verified fact ledger: each fact was checked against the official text (law, decree, court ruling or government page) and carries the figure (`value` + `unit`), the official `source_url` (a deep link to that document, never a homepage), a `quote` copied verbatim from it (language in `quote_lang`), its `locator` (article, annex or page) and `checked_on`. For these countries these facts override every other Polystate tool: where get_tax_rates, get_crypto_tax_treatment, get_residency_programs or another tool says something different, state the verified fact. Give `country` (ISO-3166 code or English name; 'Prospera' returns only the Próspera zone's facts) and an optional plain-words `query`. A set of 12 facts or fewer comes back whole, best matches first; a larger set returns up to 12 keyword matches, and with no match (or no query) an index of every fact's id, claim and source to narrow the query with. Quote figures exactly as given with source_url and checked_on; call a fact with `verification: "unverified"` unverified; `past_recheck_date: true` means the check is older than its recheck date, so say when it was checked. A country outside the ledger returns no facts and lists `available_countries`.

country.description: Country: ISO-3166 alpha-2/alpha-3 code or English name, e.g. 'PY', 'PRY', 'Paraguay', 'Honduras'. 'Prospera' returns only the Próspera zone's facts.

query.description: What the person wants to know, in plain words, e.g. 'crypto reporting threshold', 'permanent residency requirements', 'is Próspera still legal'. Omit to get every fact of a small set, or an index of a larger one.

name: get_verified_facts
title: Get verified facts with official sources
